description: This file defines a console command class 'LocationCommand' for managing location data in the Goteo project. It includes configuration details, command line options, and logic to check and update location information for projects using owner data or Google geocoding.

classes.name: LocationCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing and fixing project location data, capable of querying and updating location info via owner data or Google geocode API.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, arguments, options, and help text for the CLI command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Implements logic to process location data for projects, including displaying info and optionally fixing data.
